golang_uz.title: Go basics
golang_uz.subtitle: Lessons from go-lang.uz: syntax, types, functions, concurrency and the standard library.

summaries.golang_uz/01_birinchi_dastur.md: In this lesson we write our first Go program, one that prints text to the terminal.
summaries.golang_uz/02_ozgaruvchilar.md: A variable is a named piece of memory that holds a value. The program can read and change that value while it runs.
summaries.golang_uz/03_asosiy_malumot_turlari.md: A data type defines what a value represents and which operations can be performed on it.
summaries.golang_uz/04_operatorlar.md: An operator is a symbol or group of symbols that performs an operation on values. For example, + adds two numbers, == compares values and && combines logical conditions.
summaries.golang_uz/05_matematik_hisob_kitoblar.md: In earlier lessons we learned about numbers, operators and reading values from the console. Simple operations like addition, subtraction, multiplication and division are done with operators.
summaries.golang_uz/06_if_else_shartlari.md: A program does not always run the same instructions. Sometimes it has to choose one of several paths depending on a value or a state.
summaries.golang_uz/07_switch_operatori.md: switch chooses one of several paths based on a value or a condition.
summaries.golang_uz/08_for_sikli.md: A loop lets you repeat the same code without writing it again and again.
summaries.golang_uz/09_string_bilan_ishlash.md: string is the type that holds text and arbitrary sequences of bytes.
summaries.golang_uz/10_massiv_array.md: An array holds a fixed, known number of elements of the same type. make, in turn, is used to create slices, maps and channels.
summaries.golang_uz/11_slice_bilan_ishlash.md: A slice lets you store and work with a sequence of elements of the same type.
summaries.golang_uz/12_map_bilan_ishlash.md: A map stores key-value pairs. In a slice an element is found by its index; in a map a value is found by its key.
summaries.golang_uz/13_korsatkichlar.md: A pointer lets you refer to the address of a variable in memory.
summaries.golang_uz/14_funksiyalar.md: A function is a named block of code that performs a specific task.
summaries.golang_uz/15_funksiya_va_korsatkichlar.m: Go copies the value of every argument passed to a function. To change the original variable, you can use a pointer parameter.
summaries.golang_uz/16_struct.md: A struct combines related values of different types into a single type.
summaries.golang_uz/17_metodlar.md: A method is a function bound to a particular type. It keeps data and the operations on that data in one place.
summaries.golang_uz/18_xatolarni_boshqarish.md: While a program runs, a file may be missing, a wrong value may be entered or a network request may fail.
So far the values our programs used were written in the code. A real program often has to accept a name, a number or other data from the user.
summaries.golang_uz/20_buyruq_qatori_va_standart_o: A command-line interface (CLI) program takes arguments from the terminal and prints its result back to the terminal.
summaries.golang_uz/21_modullar_va_paketlar.md: In a Go project, packages split the code into parts, while a module defines the boundary for versioning and distributing those packages.
summaries.golang_uz/22_tashqi_kutubxonalar_va_depe: Go ships with standard packages such as fmt, strings and net/http. But a real project may need features the standard library does not have.
summaries.golang_uz/23_go_dokumentatsiyasi.md: Go documentation is generated from comments in the source code. A good comment does more than repeat the name: it explains what the API does, its important limits and its error cases.
summaries.golang_uz/24_interface.md: An interface defines not what data a type holds, but which methods it has.
summaries.golang_uz/25_enum_va_iota.md: Go has no enum keyword. Enum-like values are created with a named type and constants.
summaries.golang_uz/26_test_yozish.md: A test automatically checks that code returns the expected result. In Go, the standard testing package and the go test command are all you need to write tests.
summaries.golang_uz/27_generics.md: Generics let you use the same code safely with several types through type parameters.
A benchmark runs a piece of code repeatedly and measures how much time and memory it uses.
summaries.golang_uz/29_kod_sifati_vositalari.md: Formatting, static analysis and tests catch different problems. Running them one after another in the same workflow makes checking code before review and release easier.
A computer seems to run a browser, a music player and other programs all at the same time.
summaries.golang_uz/31_goroutine.md: A goroutine is a lightweight unit of execution managed by the Go runtime. It lets a function run concurrently with other work.
summaries.golang_uz/32_wait_group.md: sync.WaitGroup is a synchronization tool used to wait until a group of goroutines finishes its work.
summaries.golang_uz/33_channels.md: A channel is a tool for passing values of a given type between goroutines and for synchronizing their work.
summaries.golang_uz/34_channel_turlari.md: Every channel in Go passes values the same way, but its capacity and allowed direction can differ.
summaries.golang_uz/35_channel_select.md: select picks, from several channel operations, one that is ready to proceed.
summaries.golang_uz/36_mutex.md: A mutex is a synchronization tool that makes sure only one goroutine at a time accesses a shared variable.
summaries.golang_uz/37_race_detector.md: The race detector helps find places in concurrent Go code where the same memory is accessed without synchronization.
summaries.golang_uz/38_context_asoslari.md: context.Context carries a cancellation signal, a deadline and small request-scoped values to long-running work.
summaries.golang_uz/39_channel_worker_pool.md: A worker pool is a way to process many tasks with a limited number of worker goroutines.
summaries.golang_uz/40_sana_va_vaqt.md: In Go, the time package of the standard library is used to work with dates, times and durations.
summaries.golang_uz/41_fayllar_bilan_ishlash.md: A file is a way to keep data after the program has finished. Configuration, logs, JSON documents, images and reports can all be stored as files.
summaries.golang_uz/42_kataloglar.md: A directory is a file system object that groups files and other directories.
summaries.golang_uz/43_embed.md: The embed package lets you place files and directories inside the executable (binary) of a Go program at compile time.
summaries.golang_uz/44_json_bilan_ishlash.md: JSON is a text format for exchanging data. In Go, the encoding/json package decodes JSON into Go values and encodes Go values as JSON.
summaries.golang_uz/45_random.md: Random values are used in games, simulations, test data, shuffling elements and generating security tokens.
summaries.golang_uz/46_hashing.md: Hashing is the process of producing a fixed-length hash value, or digest, from data of any length.
summaries.golang_uz/47_regex.md: A regular expression, or regex for short, is a pattern that describes a recurring shape in text.
An environment variable is configuration that the operating system passes to a process as a name and a value.
